description: The 2002 forms of the RD PAGE clause (kb/Work PB5242): the page width `integer-2 {COLS | COLUMNS}`, the page limit omitted, the LAST CONTROL HEADING (LAST CH) phrase, the DE abbreviation of DETAIL in FIRST DETAIL and LAST DETAIL, and the optional word IS before a phrase's integer. §1985:XIII.3.8.2 prints `PAGE [LIMIT IS | LIMITS ARE] integer-1 [LINE | LINES] [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]` (the PDF page rendered: only PAGE, HEADING, FIRST, DETAIL, LAST and FOOTING are underlined, so `PAGE IS 20` and `PAGE LIMIT 20` stay COBOL-85, as kb/Work PB3751 reads the 2023 bracket); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.37.1 adds the rest, its SR1 the DE and CH synonyms and its SR2 an omissible integer-1, and Annex F.2 item 115 lists "PAGE LIMIT includes COLUMN phrase". Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportPageClause and VisitReportPageSubclause, once per written form (VCR row 7.45 (f)).
display: a 2002 form of the PAGE clause (report description)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (f) - the PAGE clause's width, LAST CONTROL HEADING, DE/CH and IS forms (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRPF.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRPF.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES 80 COLUMNS HEADING IS 1 FIRST DE 3 LAST CH 10 LAST DE 15 FOOTING 18.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE PLUS 1.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
